page_title: PSG 2-1 HAV | PSG v Le Havre 19/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' That's a well-taken pass by Josue Casimir (Le Havre). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
90+2' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play. Le Havre will take a throw-in.
90+1' We are about to witness a subsitution. Ilyes Housni (Le Havre) for Loic Nego.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
90' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Nuno Mendes (PSG). PSG force a corner. They send men into the box.
87' Loic Nego (Le Havre) is penalised for holding. Mathieu Vernice signals a set piece.
86' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
84' Looks like Andre Ayew (Le Havre) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
83' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.

83' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. The ball is out of play and Le Havre manage to earn a corner.
83' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
81' Substitution. Desire Doue leaves the pitch and is replaced by Presnel Kimpembe (PSG).

80' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) reacts well to meet the lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but sends a weak header well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
79' Didier Digard has decided to make a change. Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) replaces Etienne Youte Kinkoue.
79' The substitution is prepared. Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Issa Soumare.
78' An attempted cross from Issa Soumare (Le Havre) is cleared.

75' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) is first to react to a great cross from Desire Doue, but slices his shot well wide of the left post from inside the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
73' Luis Enrique has decided to substitute Bradley Barcola and he is replaced by Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG).
73' It's time for a substitution. Joao Neves (PSG) comes on in place of Kang-In Lee.
72' Bradley Barcola (PSG) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Mathieu Vernice blows for a foul.
69' Junior Mwanga (Le Havre) decides to take on a mid-range shot after a rebound falls into his path, but he was unbalanced and the shot subsequently goes well wide of the left post.
68' The current number of shots on goal is 11:1.
66' Rough tackle by Senny Mayulu (PSG). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
64' We are about to witness a substitution. Andre Ayew (Le Havre) is replacing Mahamadou Diawara.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) comes onto the pitch for Koka.
61' Substitution. Vitinha (PSG) on for Ibrahim Mbaye.
61' Luis Enrique prepares a substitution. Achraf Hakimi is replaced by Nuno Mendes (PSG).
60' GOAL! The corner comes over and Koka wins a simple header before Issa Soumare (Le Havre) nods the ball into the back of the net. 2:1.
60' Junior Mwanga (Le Havre) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
60' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The ball goes out of play. Le Havre are awarded a corner kick.

56' Mahamadou Diawara (Le Havre) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
56' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
53' Le Havre have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
50' 2 - 0 Goal! Goncalo Ramos (PSG) fires home from very close range after latching on to a pass from Senny Mayulu. The score is 2:0.
48' Bradley Barcola (PSG) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
48' Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
46' Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The end of the first half.

45+1' Bradley Barcola (PSG) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Mathieu Gorgelin leaps like a salmon to deny him.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.

45' Unbelievable miss! Lucas Beraldo (PSG) gets himself into a great position from the corner, but sends his header well wide of the right post from in front of goal when it was easier to score. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
44' Kang-In Lee (PSG) will take the corner.

44' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Desire Doue (PSG) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Mathieu Gorgelin pulls off a brilliant save. The referee signals a corner kick to PSG.
41' The corner from Kang-In Lee (PSG) is cleared away by the defence.
41' Senny Mayulu (PSG) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort. PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
39' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
38' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for PSG.

37' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the bottom left corner. However, but he couldn't beat Mathieu Gorgelin, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save. The ball goes out of play and PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
37' Desire Doue (PSG) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Mathieu Gorgelin is alert and denies him.
35' A pass from Bradley Barcola (PSG) is intercepted by Mathieu Gorgelin and the move breaks down.
33' Kang-In Lee (PSG) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

32' Kang-In Lee (PSG) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The linesman makes the right call and PSG will have a corner.
31' A pass from Josue Casimir (Le Havre) is intercepted by Matvey Safonov and the move breaks down.
27' Kang-In Lee (PSG) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
27' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. PSG will have a chance to score from a corner.
25' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Mathieu Gorgelin was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
22' Mathieu Gorgelin pulls off a great save to deny Goncalo Ramos (PSG), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal.
19' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Kang-In Lee (PSG). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

18' Great save! Senny Mayulu (PSG) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Mathieu Gorgelin. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. PSG will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
14' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) brings his opponent down. Mathieu Vernice has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
11' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from PSG.
8' 1 - 0 Goal! Desire Doue (PSG) takes a short pass from Bradley Barcola in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot inside the right post. 1:0.
3' A pass from Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) is intercepted by Mathieu Gorgelin and the move breaks down.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and PSG will have the kick-off.
Mathieu Vernice will referee today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
